meta.title: Coach Alex Timmons | Football Coaching — Texas
meta.description: Professional football coaching at Lubbock Christian HS. Offensive expertise, personalized training, and real results.

about.name: Coach Alex Timmons
about.title: WR/Pass Game Coordinator
about.bio:
Coach Alex Timmons brings 4 years of experience running the Spread system at Lubbock Christian HS. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Timmons is known for making practice reps count. Works with athletes at the Varsity level.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Timmons delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.

hero.headline: Lubbock Christian HS's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Spread System Coaching
services.description: Installation and development of the Spread offense — from core concepts to advanced adjustments that put defenses in conflict.

services.title: Skill Position Development
services.description: Individual coaching for QBs, WRs, RBs, and TEs focused on technique, route running, footwork, and pre-snap reads.

services.title: Offensive Playbook & Film Study
services.description: Playbook design tailored to your personnel, plus film sessions that sharpen in-game decision making for players and staff.
